Definition: from G989; vilification (especially against God):--blasphemy, evil speaking, railing.
BiblicalUsage: Blasphemy is the word for vilification, evil speaking, railing — against God and against men. In Matthew 12:31 Jesus says all manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men, but the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost shall not be forgiven. In Matthew 15:19 blasphemies come out of the heart, with murders and adulteries. In Ephesians 4:31 Paul says let all bitterness and clamour and evil speaking be put away from you, and in Colossians 3:8 he says put off all these: anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Paul puts blasphemy beside anger and malice for a reason: evil speaking against God and evil speaking against men grow from the same root.
